tasks.content: [SPEC-015] Backend: AdminQrsQueryDto + aggregate findAllWithSearch con lookup de usuario, búsqueda ampliada y filtros
tasks.description: backend-portaqr: (1) nuevo src/modules/qr/application/dto/admin-qrs-query.dto.ts: AdminQrsQueryDto extends PaginationDto con active?: 'all'|'active'|'inactive'|'deactivated' (@IsIn), type?: QrType (@IsEnum: dynamic/static/whatsapp/email/call/wifi/texto/list/vcard/pet/phone/map) y userId?: string (@IsMongoId); (2) mongo-qr.repository.ts: reescribir findAllWithSearch como aggregate: $match filtros combinados $and (estado active + typeQr + userId) → $addFields userIdObj ($convert to objectId, onError null) → $lookup users (localField userIdObj, foreignField _id, as userInfo) → $unwind preserveNullAndEmptyArrays → $match search (ampliado: idQr, typeQr, data.url, data.text, data.whatsappUrl, data.emailUrl, data.phoneUrl, data.wifiData.ssid, data.petData.petName, data.petData.ownerName, name, description, urlList, vcard, username/platform, petName/petBreed/ownerPhone, lat/long/address + userInfo.firstName/paternalLastName/userName/email con safeSearch) → $facet (data sort skip limit + count) — preservar contrato { data, pagination } y añadir user: { firstName, paternalLastName, maternalLastName, userName, email } | null; (3) qr.port.ts ICanGetAllQr.findAllWithSearch(page, limit, search, active, type, userId, tracking) + QrRepositoryAdapter; (4) get-all-qr.usecase.ts: execute(page, limit, search, active, type, userId, tracking); (5) qr.controller.ts findAll usa AdminQrsQueryDto y pasa active/type/userId. Unit tests CA-01, CA-02 (id/datos internos/tipo/dueño), CA-03, CA-03b, CA-03c (filtros combinados, 400 inválidos).

qr-app: (1) nuevo src/app/api/admin/qr/route.ts (GET proxy al monolito /qr pasando page/limit/search/active/type/userId, adminGuardError 401/403 patrón SPEC-013, mapeo { items, pagination }); (2) src/services/qr.service.ts: getAllQrsPaginated(page, limit, search, active, type, userId) → PaginatedResponse<QrResponseAdmin>; (3) src/interfaces/qr.ts: QrResponseAdmin = QrResponse & { user?: AdminQrOwner | null } + AdminQrOwner { firstName, paternalLastName, maternalLastName, userName, email }. Unit tests CA-04 (401 sin token, 403 rol user, 200 admin, pasa filtros).
